# appgatesdp_admin_messages_summarize (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Message category.
- `count` (Number) Number of times this Admin Message was generated.
- `created` (String) When the Admin Message generated the last time.
- `level` (String) The severity of the Admin Message.
- `message` (String) The Admin Message.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Additional metadata for the message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--metadata))
- `source` (String) The name of the Appliance(s) that generated this message. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `sources` (List of String) The name of the Appliance(s) that generated this message.

<a id="nestedatt--data--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `applied_at` (String) When the message metadata was updated.
- `applied_by` (String) The distinguished name of who updated the message metadata.
- `applied_by_device_id` (String) The device ID of the user who updated the message metadata.
- `applied_by_provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user who updated the message metadata.
- `applied_by_username` (String) The username of the user who updated the message metadata.
- `id` (String) The uuid of the message metadata.
- `message` (String) The message text. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `status` (String) The status of the message.
